title: Actor, Voice Actor Toru Shinagawa Dies at 90
content:
Knockout stated Shinagawa had been undergoing medical treatment for lymphoma.

Shinagawa was born in Hokkaido in 1935, and graduated from a performing arts institute in 1962. After graduation he joined a theater troupe run by Takeo Hodoshima.

Shinagawa was active in stage, film, television, and in voice acting. He was known for the role of a professor in the Shiroi Kyotō (White Tower) live-action series in 2003. His starring role in the 2014 film No no Nanana no ka ( Seven Weeks ) earned him a special award at the 24th Japan Film Professional Awards. In recent years he appeared in such films as Yama Onna , Ai no Komuragaeri , Doll House , and Menkyo Hennō!? .

Shinagawa appeared in the two Hagane no Renkinjutsushi: Kanketsu-hen live-action films in the Fullmetal Alchemist franchise as the King of Xerxes. He also appeared in the live-action MW film, and played the Principal in the live-action 2002 film Dark Water .

In anime, Shinagawa voiced Hisashi Imakurusu in Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex , Ak in Shōnen Santa no Daibōken , Ichiro Shinohara in Fancy Lala , Dollar Cross in Lupin III: Swallowtail Tattoo , and Professor Steamson in Project Blue Earth SOS . He had minor roles in Sorcerer Hunters , Wolf's Rain , Yu Yu Hakusho: Ghost Files , Jinki:Extend , and more.

title: Hunter x Hunter Manga Announces Hiatus, 4th Stage Play Featuring 'Chimera Ant Arc'
content:
This year's 41st issue of Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine announced on Monday that Yoshihiro Togashi 's Hunter X Hunter manga will go on hiatus, and will announce its return at a later date. In addition, a new stage play titled Hunter X Hunter The Stage 4 was announced. The new stage play will adapt the manga's "Chimera Ant Arc." The first part will run from January to February 2027, and the second part will run from July to August 2027, in Tokyo and Kyoto.

Shueisha published chapters 401 to 410 of the manga in its Weekly Shonen Jump magazine from issue 45 of 2024 to issue two of 2025. Togashi underwent surgery and announced that he had drafted the storyboard layouts for two more chapters of the manga in December 2024.

Shueisha published the manga's 38th volume in September 2024. The volume included new chapters of the manga up to chapter 400. Viz Media shipped the 38th volume in English on January 6.

Togashi revealed in March 2023 that chapter 401 of the series had been completed. He teased progress of chapter 405 in May 2024.

The manga went on hiatus in January 2023, citing health issues for the author. Shueisha stated at the time that it consulted with Togashi, and decided that the manga should not follow a weekly serialized format going forward. The editorial department added that once it knew concrete details of the manga's return and how the manga would be serialized going forward, it would reveal the details in the magazine.

Togashi launched the manga in Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in 1998. The manga inspired two television anime series, two anime films , several original video anime titles, and several stage plays.

The third stage play adaptation , titled Hunter X Hunter The Stage 3 , ran in May 2025 at the The Galaxy Theatre in Tokyo, and in June 2025 at the Sky Theater MBS in Osaka. The third stage play featured the manga's "G.I. (Greed Island) Arc."

The Hunter X Hunter Nen x Survivor "survival roguelike" game launched worldwide for iOS and Android devices on February 18.

Bushiroad Games and Eighting released the Hunter X Hunter Nen x Impact 2D 3v3 fighting game worldwide for PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch, and PC via Steam in July 2025.

title: Hindi Dub of Ragna Crimson Anime Streams on Muse India YouTube Channel
content:
The anime premiered in September 2023. Muse Asia streamed the anime in India as it aired in Japan. The anime is also streaming on Amazon 's MX Player and JioHotstar.

Ken Takahashi ( Butlers x Battlers , Fate/kaleid liner Prisma☆Illya 3rei!! ) directed the anime at SILVER LINK. , and Deco Akao ( Amanchu! , Arakawa Under the Bridge , Noragami ) wrote and oversaw the series scripts. Shinpei Aoki (key animator for Fate/kaleid liner Prisma Illya franchise ) designed the characters. Kōji Fujimoto ( Sus4 Inc. ) and Osamu Sasaki composed the music.

Kobayashi launched the manga in Gangan Joker in March 2017. Square Enix had announced in April 2021 that the manga was nearing its "final battle," and the manga entered its final arc with the 11th volume, which shipped in August 2022. The 17th compiled volume of the manga shipped on May 21.

title: Anime India Responds to Artist Alley Vendors' Allegations of Mismanagement at Mumbai 2026 Event
content:
Artist TAO claimed to ANN that several vendors had to set up without tables at the event after paying between ₹12,000 to ₹22,000 for a booth including two tables, two chairs, and a power socket. They stated some Artist Alley booths were not provided with tables until 2:00 p.m. to 3:00 p.m. on August 28. TAO and several other booths were allegedly not provided with power sockets until August 29. Sumit Edison made some of the same complaints on social media along with alleging that Artist Alley customers were removed from the lane multiple times in order to utilize the lane for VIP guests. _cosytales_ alleged similar mismanagement on social media, also complaining about the lack of internet and lack of communication from convention staff.

ANN reached out to Anime India regarding these allegations, and in response, representatives told ANN: "As the event scaled up, we definitely encountered some operational issues from vendors that we will strive to improve."

TAO also alleged that the management allowed AI art to be sold at the event despite the rules stating that AI art was not allowed in the Artist Alley. They also alleged that exhibitors displayed AI generated animation in their presentations. Anime India did not confirm or deny the alleged AI use, but told ANN, "We will also improve due diligence to be stricter and tighter to avoid any AI usage by any sponsor or exhibitor at the event."

Cosplayer Qwinnnbee alleged in her statement to ANN that there were repeated instances of poor behavior from staff and volunteers as well as harassment from attendees.

Anime India also stated to ANN, "This is our second year and We will improve with every anime India edition." The next Anime India event will take place in Hyderabad.

Naruto director Hayato Date ( Naruto Shippūden , Flame of Recca ) attended the Mumbai 2026 event as a guest. Voice actor Akari Yura ( The Beginning After The End , Catch Me at the Ballpark! ) performed as a musical act at the convention's concert, and Luna Goami ( Sparks of Tomorrow ) and Mofmofmo performed at the concert. ASCA ( Sword Art Online: Alicization , Edens Zero ) also performed at the event. Producer Ryōta Hasegawa ( Dr. Stone , Sakamoto Days ) attended the event as a guest. The event hosted meet and greets for all four musical artists as well as with Ryōta Hasegawa . Kadokawa participated in a "fireside chat" in the event's Animation & More Summit, as did ' Sony YAY!'

Anime India hosted voice actor Kazuhiko Inoue ( Naruto , Parasyte -the maxim- , 2025 Ranma ½ ) as a guest at its event in Delhi. Delhi Anime India took place at Yashobhoomi Convention Centre on June 6 and June 7. YURiKA ( Little Witch Academia , Miss Kuroitsu From the Monster Development Department ) performed at the event as well.

Anime India hosted its Kolkata event at Biswa Bangla Mela Prangan on February 14 and February 15. The event featured a panel and a workshop by director Susumu Mitsunaka ( Haikyu!! director, Weathering With You key animator).

After the Kolkata event, core team of organizers comprising one employee and several contractors left the organizing company due to alleged poor working conditions.

Anime India's previous Mumbai event took place in 2025 from August 22 through August 24 at NESCO BEC in Mumbai. Director Tetsuro Araki attended the event as the "flagship guest." Voice actor Tsunko ( D4DJ First Mix , D4DJ All Mix ), president of Avex Pictures ' Hideo Katsumata , and DJ Tōko Nakamura also attended the event as guests. Hikari Dobashi attended the event as an exhibitor representing TV Tokyo .

title: Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid Feature Film UK Blu-ray Released on Monday
content:
"Miss Kobayashi, Tohru, Kanna, and Iruru's peaceful lives are shattered when Kanna's father, Kimun Kamui, leader of the chaos faction, arrives and forces her to return to the Dragon World to fix a past mistake. With a war brewing between Chaos and Harmony, Kanna must find a way to unite the two worlds but is torn between her loyalty to her friends and her father's demands. Miss Kobayashi, however, refuses to let her go and tries to mend Kanna and her father's broken bond. As dragons clash, Iruru uncovers a hidden force manipulating the war. Can they stop the war before it consumes both worlds?"

Tatsuya Ishihara ( Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid S ; Love, Chunibyo & Other Delusions! ) directed the film, which features returning cast members Mutsumi Tamura as Kobayashi, Yūki Kuwahara as Tohru, and Maria Naganawa as Kanna. The new cast members include Fumihiko Tachiki as Kimun Kamui and Nobunaga Shimazaki as Azad. Shiori Sugiura voices Ilulu in the film, replacing Tomomi Mineuchi who quit voice acting in 2022.

fhána performs the opening theme song "Namida no Parade" (Parade of Tears). kotringo performs the insert song "Negaigoto" (Wish).

"The man who was feared by all villains, and revered by all hitmen—one day, fell in love! When Sakamoto met Aoi the convenience store clerk, it was love at first sight; and just like that, he retired. Sakamoto got married, had a daughter, opened a mom-and-pop store in a quiet town, and completely transformed… into a plus size!

"To ensure a peaceful life with his beloved family, the legendary ex-hitman takes on a relentless stream of assassin attacks. This action-packed story of the ordinary and extraordinary begins here!"

Masaki Watanabe ( KADO - The Right Answer , Bartender, several Battle Spirits anime) directed the anime at TMS Entertainment . Taku Kishimoto ( BLUELOCK , Haikyu!! , Moriarty the Patriot ) oversaw the series scripts, and Yō Moriyama ( Lupin the IIIrd: Goemon's Blood Spray , Lupin the IIIrd: Jigen's Gravestone ) was the character designer.

Vaundy performed the opening theme song "Hashire Sakamoto" (Run, Sakamoto). Conton Candy performed the ending theme song "Futsū" (Normal).

Suzuki published a one-shot titled "Sakamoto" in Jump Giga in December 2019, and then launched the main manga in Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in November 2020. Viz Media and MANGA Plus are publishing the manga in English digitally.

The series is described as follows:

"Shu lost his entire family in a special incident caused by demons called "D Hazards". He makes a contract with Kisara, an A-class demon, and she exterminates demons for him in order to solve past D Hazards and the mystery of the incident. The contract is to obtain the devil's power by kissing in exchange for his memories. A love triangle between a man, a devil, and his ex-girlfriend. With Kisara's great power, the truth is revealed little by little... Their uncertain bond teeters between love and contract. Where is their destiny headed..?"

Tomoya Tanaka ( ēlDLIVE assistant director, Visual Prison ) directed the anime at A-1 Pictures . Fumiaki Maruto , best known for the Saenai Heroine no Sodate-kata light novels and the White Album 2 visual novels, was both writing and supervising the scripts for the anime. Date A Live and Hyperdimension Neptunia illustrator Tsunako designed the characters.

Shunsaku Yano ( Try Knights , Record of Grancrest War ) was in charge of the world setting. Masaaki Takiyama ( Fate/Extra Last Encore , Nyaruko: Crawling with Love! ) served as both animation character designer and chief animation director. Chiaki Furuzumi ( Sword Art Online: Alicization - War of Underworld Part 2 , Black Butler: Book of the Atlantic ) was also the sub-character designer and chief animation director. Yoshiaki Fujisawa ( The Eccentric Family , GATE , Love Live! School idol project , Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation ) composed the music.

title: 'Ojisan wa Kawaii Mono ga Osuki.' Unveils Additional Cast, Theme Songs, Second Promo
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Tsutomu 's Ojisan wa Kawaii Mono ga Osuki. ( Pops Loves Kawaii Stuff ) manga unveiled additional cast, the theme songs, and second promotional video on Monday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on October 4 at 10.00 p.m. on Tokyo MX, followed by BS Asahi and Yomiuri TV on October 5.

Cast Rio Moshina: Kaori Maeda ( Love Live! Nijigasaki Gakuen School Idol Doukoukai ) Mirai Usuama: Miharu Hanai ( Selection Project ) Haruo Koba: Satoshi Satoshi ( Yumemiru Danshi wa Genjitsushugisha ) Hoho Takebayashi: Mie Sonozaki ( Great Pretender )

Vocalist Yusei Yagi ( Kabushikigaisha Magi-Lumière 2nd Season ) is performing the opening theme "LIKE³." Voice actress Kaori Maeda ( Kuroiwa Medaka ni Watashi no Kawaii ga Tsuujinai ) is performing the ending theme "Toutoi♡Kaiwai." The opening theme is previewed in the second promotional video below.

Tomoe Makino ( Aharen-san wa Hakarenai ) is directing the anime at LIDENFILMS . Yuu Satou ( Haite Kudasai, Takamine-san ) is handling the series composition and script. Tomomi Kimura ( Kotarou wa Hitorigurashi ) is serving as character designer and chief animation director. Alisa Okehazama ( Himekishi wa Barbaroi no Yome ) is composing the music.

Tsutomu began drawing the comedy slice of life manga on the Comic Polaris website in July 2017. Flex Comics published the 12th volume on August 7.

A live-action drama adaptation aired on Yomiuri TV in five episodes from August to September in 2020. Coinciding with the release of the fourth volume, BookLive released a manga video starring voice actors Kenjirou Tsuda and Takuya Satou as Mitsutaka Oji and Wataru Naruto, respectively.

title: Black Clover Anime's 2nd Season Reveals October 3 Debut, Ending Theme by One or Eight
content:
The anime will air on TV Tokyo and its affiliates starting on October 3 at 11:00 p.m. The anime will stream in Japan on Anime Times , Lemino , U-NEXT , and Anime Hōdai .

The magazine also revealed that ONE OR EIGHT will perform the ending theme song "Yellow Brick Road."

Crunchyroll will preview the anime as part of its Crunchyroll Anime Nights program in theaters in the U.S. on September 21, and will then stream the anime as it airs.

WANIMA performs the opening theme song "Kienai Riyū" (The Reason that Won't Disappear).

Ayataka Tanemura , the director of episodes 153-170 of the first Black Clover anime and the film Black Clover: Sword of the Wizard King , will direct the second season. Studio Pierrot will return to animate the new season.

The Black Clover anime last aired in March 2021 with its 170th episode.

The anime premiered in Japan in October 2017. The show was originally listed with 51 episodes, but it continued into a new season with episode 52 in October 2018, and continued on again into a new season in October 2019. Crunchyroll streamed the series in Japanese with English subtitles, and Funimation streamed the show's English dub. The anime debuted on Adult Swim 's Toonami programming block in December 2017.

The Black Clover: Sword of the Wizard King ( Black Clover: Mahо̄tei no Ken ) anime film opened in Japan and debuted on Netflix worldwide in June 2023.

Tabata launched Black Clover in Weekly Shonen Jump in February 2015. The manga moved to the quarterly Jump Giga magazine in 2023. Viz Media is publishing the manga digitally and in print, and Shueisha 's MANGA Plus service is also publishing the manga digitally.

Tabata launched Black Clover in Weekly Shonen Jump in February 2015. The manga moved to the quarterly Jump Giga magazine in 2023. Viz Media is publishing the manga digitally and in print, and Shueisha 's MANGA Plus service is also publishing the manga digitally.

title: Yomawari: The Long Night Collection, Lost in the Dark Games Head West on PS5
content:
NIS America announced on Saturday that the Yomawari: The Long Night Collection and Yomawari: Lost in the Dark games will launch for the PlayStation 5 in the west on November 5.

Yomawari: The Long Night Collection , the bundle release for the Switch version of Nippon Ichi Software 's Yomawari: Night Alone and Yomawari: Midnight Shadows games, launched in North America and Europe in October 2018.

Yomawari: Lost in the Dark debuted for Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, and PC via Steam in North America in October 2022. The game launched for Switch and PS4 in Japan in April 2023. It later launched for the PS5 in Japan on May 14, 2026.

In the original Yomawari: Night Alone game, players take the role of a little girl who uses a single flashlight to search in the night for her lost sister and dog. The sequel uses a similar concept as the first game, but with two new girls searching for each other.

Nippon Ichi Software developed the first Yomawari game for PS Vita and released it in Japan in October 2015, and NIS America released physical and digital editions for the game in North America and Europe in October 2016. The game also launched worldwide on PC in October 2016.

Yomawari: Midnight Shadows shipped in Japan for the PlayStation 4 and PlayStation Vita in August 2017 and NIS America released the game for PS4, PS Vita and PC via Steam in North America and Europe in October 2017.

title: Qliphah in Providence's Shadow Game Posts Gameplay Trailer
content:
Arc System Works streamed a gameplay trailer for its upcoming Qliphah in Providence's Shadow game on Friday.

The trailer previews gameplay mechanics where players can stack skills within a limited amount of time to deal damage to enemies and counterattack by overlapping skills.

The Nintendo eShop also began acceping pre-orders for the game on Friday, and pre-orders and early purchases will bundle three additional skins for the protagonists Hizuki Rena and Soma Hoshigami, and an extra "Voidfall" battle with 16 high-difficulty battles and unique rewards.

Arc System Works describes the game:

In Qliphah in Providence's Shadow, the stage is Tokyo after the World Collapse — a city where reality is being eroded and the grotesque entities known as Anomalies run rampant. While working a part-time courier job, the young man Soma Hoshigami is attacked by an Anomaly and left in a "Half-turned" state, human and Anomaly intermingled. He is taken into custody as "Lost Property" by Rena Hizuki, an investigator with the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department's Public Safety Bureau, Foreign Affairs Fifth Division (commonly known as the Public Safety Anomaly Response Division). In a world corrupted by Anomalies and facing total reality collapse, players take on the roles of Rena and Soma as they pursue the demonic drug "Tiny True" flooding the streets, the "Stigmas" (patterns carved into the body that are spreading among the youth and eroding their flesh), and a mysterious cult operating from the shadows. Battle and strike down powerful enemies in stylish fashion, cutting them away with flair, as you unravel the mystery of the world's transformation.

The "tactical counter-timeline RPG" features two protagonists and is fully voice-acted. It will launch for PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch, and PC via Steam and the Epic Games Store on September 24.

title: Fukakōryoku no I Love You Manga Goes on Hiatus Due to Creator's Health
content:
Manga creator Mizuki Hoshino announced on Friday that their Fukakōryoku no I Love You (I Love You by Force Majeure) manga will go on hiatus due to their poor health. Hoshino added that they will announce the manga's return at a later date.

The manga centers on first-year high school student Sena Kodama who tries to suppress her feelings for the school heartthrob and her senior Wataya, but always ends up getting swept away by his charms. Sena wants to get over her feelings, but somehow ends up having a "try-out date" with Wataya.

Hoshino launched the manga in Shueisha 's Margaret magazine in August 2023. Shueisha published the manga's first compiled book volume in November 2023, and the ninth volume on June 25.

Hoshino launched the Tiger & Dragon series in Shueisha 's Bessatsu Margaret magazine in February 2022. Shueisha shipped the fourth and final compiled book volume in April 2023. Seven Seas released all four volumes of the manga in English.
